selection: Purposive engineering challenge sample selected for sector, issuer size, fiscal calendar and reporting-boundary diversity before inspecting outcome differences. Not a probability sample and not representative of market-wide leakage prevalence.
metadata: SEC submissions API, including historical pagination files
raw_source: SEC EDGAR Archives original primary documents plus issuer XBRL schema and linkbases, instance and FilingSummary where present
available_at_rule: UTC acceptanceDateTime plus 24 hours; fixed conservative research convention, not measured investor receipt time
historical_scope: Specified annual filing set only; no claim of earliest public market knowledge
holdout_policy: Raw bytes may be downloaded before freeze; values must not be parsed or inspected until normalization and query rules are frozen
compression: gzip with mtime=0; source manifest records SHA-256 of original and compressed bytes
window_note: SEC filingDate is a filing-calendar date; the acceptance cutoff is an additional UTC instant filter. Both conditions must hold. Selection audit records excluded accession counts.
